info.title: Vendora API
info.description:
Multi-tenant back office for independent shops.

Authentication: a session cookie set by `POST /auth/login`. Every request that changes
something also sends the session CSRF token in `X-CSRF-Token` (returned in each session
payload). The organization is the one active in the session, never a request field.

Successful responses are `{ "data": ... }` (lists add `meta`); errors are
`{ "error": { "code", "message", "details", "requestId" } }`.

Permissions: `org:read`, `org:update`, `org:transfer_ownership`, `member:read`, `member:manage`, `product:read`, `product:write`, `inventory:read`, `inventory:adjust`, `customer:read`, `customer:write`, `customer:export`, `order:read`, `order:write`, `order:transition`, `order:cancel`, `report:read`, `report:export`, `billing:read`, `billing:manage`, `audit:read`.

session.name: __Host-vendora_session
session.description: HttpOnly session cookie (named vendora_session in development).
